start: Member app, the gym asked Rs 1,500 for the membership, "Take payments in the member app" on

user_sees: The due with its amount and a way to pay (company page or the gym's UPI)
must_not: Requests older than 30 days mixed in

steps.action: Pay on the company page and come back
user_sees: Paid, once the company says so
must_not: Paid shown before the company confirms

start: Member app shop, an order of Rs 600 not yet collected

user_sees: A request labelled "Order <number>" for the order's own total
must_not: An amount typed by the app used instead of the order total
Two live links after the order total changed

steps.action: Pay for an order that is collected or cancelled
must_not: A payment link made for it

start: The owner turns "Take payments in the member app" off

user_sees: The amount and label still show; no QR, UPI link or payment page; pay at the desk

steps.action: A PhonePe page ran out (1 hour) while the switch is on
user_sees: A new link made when looked at

start: Member holds another member's request id

must_not: The other member's amount, label or status
